en.title: imipenem and cilastatin: 2.2, Table 2 and 2.2, Table 2 give different instructions for one patient
en.summary: 2.2, Table 2 reads “4 weeks to 3 months of age”. 2.2, Table 2 reads “1 to 4 weeks of age”. Example: An infant aged exactly 4 weeks matches both rows: every 6 hours and every 8 hours. The same text is in 6 labels from 3 labelers in the DailyMed release of 29 October 2026.
en.impact: Potential effect on a prescribing decision: medium. Arxo does not say which instruction is correct and gives no dose.
